text:
The birds are going to sing. I feel it in my sides.

Because wings tremble in me that I never saw grow.

And suddenly the trees shake their messages

so I may gather them and carry them through the wind.


They will sprout stronger. I hear the earth

slide its warm moistures under my soles;

and a stream is not born unless a woman wants

it to gird her legs with its thin cloth.


I know gardens are coming. I know steeds leap.

Learning all that has cost me my life.

And I leave it to you in the marble, in case someone should find it

and want to know how so much is forgotten.

translation.title: Grace
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the bodily signs of birds, streams, and the life left in marble.
